meanings.en: other forms: нас (gen/acc), нам (dat), нами (instr), нас (prep)
it is necessary, one needs to
meanings.note: + dative of the person + infinitive: мне нужно позвонить

examples.trans: I need to make a call.

meanings.en: to have a talk, to speak (with someone)
other forms: меня (gen/acc), мне (dat), мной (instr), мне (prep)

examples.trans: If you don't want to, suit yourself.

meanings.note: + instrumental; со before some consonant clusters: со всеми

meanings.en: other forms: тебя (gen/acc), тебе (dat), тобой (instr), тебе (prep)

examples.trans: I want to show you something.

examples.text: Без лишних ушей обсудим твоё назначение.
examples.trans: Without extra ears we will discuss your appointment.
The partners discussed the terms of the deal in detail.
I'll be there in ten minutes.

meanings.note: points at something: это моё = that's mine

meanings.en: other forms: этого, этому, это, этим, этом

examples.trans: I love our town very much.

examples.text: У нас с тобой серьёзный разговор.
examples.trans: You and I have a serious talk to have.
We could open a salon for you.

meanings.note: понимаешь? = you know? do you understand?

examples.trans: I want to go to the sea, you know?

examples.text: Мы сделали много, но надо ещё.
examples.trans: We've done a lot, but we need more.
I want to, but I can't.

meanings.note: to run for a second term

examples.trans: He is running for a second term.
I am not going to run away.
The dog is running away into the park.

meanings.en: nowhere, not anywhere (direction/destination, used with не or нет)

examples.text: Слушайте, да не нужно вам никуда ехать.
examples.trans: Listen, you don't need to go anywhere.

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates

examples.trans: Why are we going so slowly?

meanings.note: the imperative 'слушай' starts a sentence, like 'look, ...'
adds emphasis to the word before it

examples.trans: Arkady Borisovich fell down the stairs!

meanings.note: мне кажется = I think, it seems to me
у меня болит живот = I have a stomach ache

meanings.en: urgently, right away; predicative: it is urgent

examples.trans: I need to make a phone call urgently.
I grew up in a communal flat.
The toilet is in the corridor.
